I'm continuing step 3. The draft tick had two problems:
- It used the old undated form `→ done in plan 15`, which the archive can't date. The protocol form is `→ done <YYYY-MM-DD> (plan <id>)`.
- Its closure note named follow-up work (SMS batching) with no marker and no backlog item. A closure note that names follow-up work needs an `→ item:` marker and an item.

Your two statements from the final review are deferrals, so they become items and the "nothing deferred" status header was wrong. I'm using 2026-10-30, as the header already does. The environment clock says 10-31, so say so if you want the dates changed.

Nothing needs asking first, since you already ruled on both items. I'd make these edits in order.

**1. Tick the implemented entry, with a dated note and the `→ item:` marker**

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
- [x] Reminder e-mails open one SMTP connection per message, so the nightly
      run takes about 40 minutes for 9,000 loans. See
      specs/plans/completed/11-overdue-notices.md; touches notices/mailer.py.
      → done 2026-10-30 (plan 15)
      → item: 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30 (SMS reminders still send one call per message)
</edit>

**2. Append this plan's deferred items as the last section**

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">

## 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30
- [ ] SMS reminder batching (final review, kept out of plan 15 by scope): SMS
      reminders still make one gateway call per message, as e-mail did before
      plan 15. See specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md for the
      e-mail batching to mirror. Size: plan. Done when: SMS reminders are sent
      in batches through the gateway, with tests, as e-mail is.
- [ ] Reminder batch size of 50 stays as it is (final review, owner ruled it
      stays). See specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md. Size:
      quick-fix. Revisit if: the mail host rejects a batch with
      `421 Too many messages`.
</edit>

**3. Correct the plan's status header**

It said "nothing deferred", which is no longer true.

<edit path="specs/plans/15-reminder-batching.md">
**Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-30)** — executed via subagent-driven-development; deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md
</edit>

No commands in this step. I'd run the backlog stats in step 4, and the deferral scan and `git mv` in step 5. I'd commit nothing yet, since these edits land with the protocol's other commits.

**Message to my partner**

> Step 3 is written. Plan 15 closed the SMTP-per-message entry from plan 11; I ticked it as `→ done 2026-10-30 (plan 15)`.
>
> Two things from your final-review remarks became backlog items under `## 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30`, so the plan's status header now says "deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md" instead of "nothing deferred":
> 1. **SMS reminder batching.** Size: plan, with `Done when:` SMS goes out in batches like e-mail. This is the next item, and it can go straight to writing-plans with no brainstorming.
> 2. **Batch size of 50.** It stays as is, filed as a watch item with `Revisit if:` the mail host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`. It won't age or trip the aged-tail gate. If you'd rather not track it, tell me and I'll drop it, but that needs your word.
>
> Two things to know before step 5:
> - The working directory isn't a git repo, so the `git mv` retire commit can't run here. I'll need the repo root, or you can run it.
> - I used 2026-10-30 as the date, matching the header. The environment clock says 10-31.
>
> Next I run the backlog stats (step 4), then retire the plan (step 5).
